claims.text: The buyer is seeking approximately 1 ton (1000 kg) of scrap titanium nets.
The buyer is interested in various forms of scrap titanium netting, including industrial titanium mesh/screening, damaged or offcut titanium nets, and titanium alloy nets.
claims.value: scrap titanium nets (including industrial mesh/screening, damaged/offcut, titanium alloy)

claims.text: The condition of the scrap titanium nets can be scrap, damaged, or offcut material.
The buyer is seeking suppliers located in Nigeria and China.
Suppliers must be able to provide documentation regarding the material’s origin and composition, if possible.
Pricing will be negotiated based on the material’s purity, quantity, and condition.

Interested suppliers are requested to provide detailed information about their available scrap titanium nets, including quantity, material composition, condition, location, photographs (if available), and quoted price.
claims.value: quantity, material composition, condition, location, photographs, quoted price
